ai_agent.description: AI-driven financial operators operating under constitutional constraints

governance.description: Constitutional oversight function requiring human consensus

human.description: Authenticated human users operating through verified identity

system.description: Internal runtime processes that maintain system integrity

conflict_resolution.principle: Speed never outranks safety. Autonomy never outranks authority. The system may be slow but it must be correct.

priority_order.description: Constitutional invariants are absolute. They cannot be overridden by any lower priority.
Physical and digital asset custody, reserve integrity, and collateral protection.
Legal and regulatory requirements imposed by external authorities.
Double-entry balance, audit completeness, event immutability.
Successfully completing an initiated financial operation.
System throughput, latency optimization, resource utilization.
AI agent ability to act without human intervention.

INV-001.description: The system of record is an append-only event log. No state may change without a corresponding event. Events, once published, are never modified or deleted.
INV-001.name: event_immutability
INV-001.rule: Every state change requires an immutable event

INV-002.description: Every financial movement must be recorded as a balanced double-entry journal. Total debits must exactly equal total credits for every journal entry. Zero exceptions.
INV-002.name: double_entry_balance
INV-002.rule: No ledger mutation without balanced journal entry

INV-003.description: Every command is executed under a specific identity with specific capabilities scoped to specific resources. If the actor lacks the required capability, scope, or condition, the command must be rejected before execution.
INV-003.name: authority_boundary
INV-003.rule: No actor may exceed granted authority

INV-004.description: AI agents may not create new capabilities, grant capabilities to other actors, modify existing authority boundaries, or escalate their own permissions. Only the Governance domain through human approval may modify authority.
INV-004.name: agent_financial_authority_prohibition
INV-004.rule: No agent may create, grant, or modify financial authority

INV-005.description: Every command that affects financial state must emit events that fully describe what happened, who caused it, when it occurred, and what the before/after state was. The audit trail must be queryable by Governance domain.
INV-005.name: audit_trail_completeness
INV-005.rule: Every financial action must produce an auditable event trail

INV-006.description: Events are observations of state changes, not instructions to mutate state. The source of truth is the append-only event log. Projections are derived read models that interpret events but are not themselves authoritative. If a projection disagrees with the event log, the event log is authoritative.
INV-006.name: event_describes_does_not_mutate
INV-006.rule: Events do not mutate reality. Events describe reality. Projections interpret reality.

INV-007.description: No optimization for throughput, latency, or efficiency may compromise asset safety, reserve integrity, or custody guarantees. When performance and safety conflict, safety wins unconditionally.
INV-007.name: value_preservation_priority

INV-008.description: Every command must pass through four gates before execution: 1. Identity verification (who is acting) 2. Capability check (is the actor authorized for this action) 3. Scope check (is the actor authorized for this specific resource) 4. Policy evaluation (does this action comply with all active policies) Failure at any gate prevents execution.
INV-008.name: command_execution_gates
INV-008.rule: No command executes without identity, capability, scope, and policy validation

INV-009.description: When the system cannot determine the definitive state of a financial operation (e.g., external settlement pending, attestation timeout, network partition), the state must be recorded as UNKNOWN or PENDING with full context. The system must never assume success or silently resolve ambiguity.
INV-009.name: unknown_state_representation
INV-009.rule: Unknown financial states must be represented explicitly, never hidden

INV-010.description: AI agents operate within the same constitutional constraints as human actors. Agents may not issue commands directly to services that bypass the command bus, policy engine, or audit pipeline. All agent actions must flow through the standard command → policy → execute → event pipeline.
INV-010.name: no_autonomous_constitutional_bypass
INV-010.rule: No autonomous agent may bypass constitutional enforcement
